purpose: Attempt the shortest premise-level path from an existing 3+3 structural promotion to one covariance-complete observable package by replacing the failed Chandra gas route with independent XMM data and replacing the 0.5-arcsec lens convention with image-measurement covariance. No dynamical, Weyl, or gravity response is fit.
disclosure: HEASARC metadata for XMM ObsID 0093030201, including archived status, 58,916-second duration, public availability, and approximately 706 MB located data, were known before this freeze.
At the initial freeze, a published analysis implied substantially shorter flare-cleaned exposure than the gross XMM duration; exact cleaned values had not yet been measured locally.
The existing Jauzac table has 21 spectroscopic images from seven families, including three images from three families inside the frozen 5-arcsec dynamics support.
The existing 0.5-arcsec diagonal coordinate covariance is a declared likelihood convention, not a measurement covariance, and cannot satisfy this stage.
Execution update: XMM X1, X2a, X2b1, and X2b2 now pass. MOS2 and pn are retained; MOS1 is excluded by its CCD5 FWC/corner sector scale.

Execution update: all six immutable X3 annuli pass with 76,279.260 conservative net counts and minimum annular S/N 84.091. This authorizes X4 response calibration and an XMM-specific likelihood freeze, not a temperature, density, gas-mass, response, or gravity fit.

Execution update: the MOS2+pn X4 direct, a02-to-a01 cross-region, and central-source interface passes. The nominal 650 map request is rejected because SAS realized 81-detector-unit pixels versus the frozen 80-unit ceiling.

Execution update: the promoted 920-to-1302 convergence gate passes for MOS2 and pn under all unchanged response and geometry thresholds. This authorizes the full X4 response package, not a gas, dynamics, lensing, or gravity fit.

completed_inputs.dynamics_profile: Four finite MUSE pPXF bins on 0-5 arcsec support with frozen covariance and accepted baseline/sensitivity checks.
completed_inputs.stellar_light: Published Hernquist baseline plus local two-band HST total-light profile; physical BCG/ICL split is non-identifiable and must remain marginalized.
completed_inputs.satellite_stars: Held-out-validated membership likelihood and 2000-draw off-center acceleration covariance.
completed_inputs.lens_coordinates: 21 spectroscopic image coordinates and redshifts are source-traceable; measurement-level coordinate covariance is missing.
completed_inputs.gas: The Chandra reduction route failed its frozen exposure/background/CALDB gates; no gas likelihood is accepted.

xmm_metadata_gate.selection_rule: Use the sole archived XMM pointing within 12 arcmin of the frozen RX J2129 center; do not add off-axis or unrelated fields after seeing a gas profile.

xmm_reduction_gate.software: Freeze an exact XMM SAS plus calibration-file environment manifest before event processing.
xmm_reduction_gate.flare_filter: Predeclare high-energy light-curve bands, bins, and iterative clipping before viewing the cluster surface-brightness profile.
xmm_reduction_gate.background: Use filter-wheel-closed plus unexposed-corner normalization and a local outer-annulus cross-check; require every fitted background scale to remain in [0.5, 2.0].
xmm_reduction_gate.point_sources: Freeze an energy-band-independent union mask before radial gas fitting.
xmm_reduction_gate.failure: If fewer than two EPIC instruments pass exposure, background, calibration, and field-center gates, stop the XMM route without changing thresholds.

gas_likelihood_gate.projection: Publish one joint posterior for electron-density and temperature parameters and propagate the same draws into spherical gas mass and projected gas surface density; never fit separate dynamical and lensing gas profiles.
gas_likelihood_gate.failure: Stop if five annuli or their covariance cannot be supported. Do not report a one-anchor or diagonal-only substitute.

hst_astrometric_covariance_gate.measurement: For each source-table coordinate, fit a local PSF-convolved flexible elliptical light model plus tilted background independently in F814W and F125W; use 500 noise and local-background bootstrap draws. A union segmentation mask is frozen before centroid fitting.
hst_astrometric_covariance_gate.covariance: Combine per-image bootstrap covariance with shared WCS-registration draws to create a full 42x42 measurement covariance. Off-diagonal terms must arise only from shared astrometric registration, not from a mass model or fitted lens residual.
forbidden: published or independently fitted lens-model residuals
the existing fixed 0.5-arcsec coordinate convention as a measurement error
moving, deleting, or relabeling an image after inspecting a lens prediction
hst_astrometric_covariance_gate.failure: If any of images 5.2, 6.3, or 8.2 fails, or fewer than 18 field images pass, retain the source coordinates but do not claim theory-neutral joint covariance.

stage_outcomes.outcome: One exact public XMM observation and the two local HST bands pass source, duration, size, coordinate, and checksum/header feasibility gates.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: Every metadata gate passes and exact files are frozen before download or centroid measurement.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Move the same feasibility screen to MACS J1206; do not return to failed RX J2129 Chandra products.

stage_outcomes.outcome: At least two EPIC instruments retain at least 15 ks and 25% exposure, with accepted calibration/background products, while at least 18 HST images including all three inner images yield measurement covariances.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: Both the XMM reduction and HST astrometric gates pass independently.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Stop the failed branch exactly; do not repair one branch with a lens or gravity model.

stage_outcomes.outcome: At least five gas annuli from 10-500 kpc and a full 42x42 image-coordinate covariance join the already accepted dynamics, light, and satellite likelihoods in one source-traceable same-system observable package.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: All uncertainty, covariance, component-marginalization, and common-center gates pass. This authorizes only a separate dynamical/Weyl identifiability audit.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: If either gas or astrometry fails, RX J2129 stays structural-only and MACS J1206 becomes the next availability screen.
